title: France's Ankama Presents Fantasy TV Anime Aoki Denshō Welsh & Shedar
content: A website opened on Wednesday for Aoki Denshō Welsh & Shedar (The Azure Legend: Welsh & Shedar), the original television anime by French entertainment company Ankama which will premiere on October 2 on Tokyo MX at 9:25 p.m. JST (8:25 a.m. EDT).
author: ANN

title: 'Demons' Crest' Announces Additional Cast
content: The official website for the original net anime adaptation of Reki Kawahara 's Demons' Crest light novel announced additional cast on Wednesday. The anime is scheduled to premiere on Amazon Prime Video on November 6.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Shangri-La Frontier Season 3 Key Visual Revealed, Two Consecutive Cours Starting on January 10, 2027
content: Shangri-La Frontier Season 3 revealed the first key visual, confirming two consecutive cours and a January 10, 2027 premiere date. The anime is set to continue with the Galaxia Heroes: Chaos action, which was previously teased in a trailer . Studio C2C is again in charge of the animation.
author: Anime Corner

title: Entergram Announces Vtuber Azusa Honami's Azure Memoria Game
content: Entergram opened a teaser website on Tuesday to announce the "consumer game" Azure Memoria starring VTuber Azusa Honami, who also supervises the game. title: Hi Score Girl's Rensuke Oshikiri, Etrange Overlord's Roman Kitayama Present Noroi Ayashi Horror RPG
content: Hong Kong-based publisher Game Source Entertainment announced on Wednesday Noroi Ayashi: The ∞th Oddity, a new horror role-playing game from developer Clover Lab., inc. The game will launch for Nintendo Switch, Switch 2, and PC via Steam in the second quarter of 2027.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll Acquires 7.03% of Japanese Media Company Link-U
content: Japanese media company Link-U Group announced a new business partnership with Crunchyroll on Monday. The Link-U Group issued an third-party allotment of its shares at 856 yen (about US$5.50) per share, and Crunchyroll will acquire 917 million yen (about US$5.91 million) of those shares of Link-U.
author: ANN

title: Shogakukan Launches 'Rumiko Takahashi Fantasy Manga Awards'
content: This year's 42nd and 43rd combined issue of Shogakukan 's Weekly Shonen Sunday magazine announced its new " Rumiko Takahashi Fantasy Manga Awards" on Wednesday, and the organizers are currently accepting manga entries until January 11, 2027. The contest is open to professional and amateur manga creators.
author: ANN

title: Mazenchu Food Characters Get TV Anime on October 7
content: Graphic design company Torch announced on Wednesday that its Mazenchu character brand will receive a anime that will begin airing as the first original anime within Kansai TV 's morning news and lifestyle program Yoidon! on October 7.
author: ANN

title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Reveals 11 Character Posters Ahead of October Premiere
content: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 has revealed a new set of 11 character posters ahead of its October 2, 2026 premiere. It will lead up to the upcoming movie , which will premiere in Japan on December 11 with an original story by the author Natsu Hyuuga. The second cour of Season 3 is scheduled for April 2027.
author: Anime Corner
